details:
This update for ignition fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-78659: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers (bsc#1286987).
- CVE-2026-78660: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed framing-related headers (bsc#1287049).
- CVE-2026-78663: golang.org/x/net/http2: double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams (bsc#1287144).
- CVE-2026-78669: golang.org/x/net/http2: excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes (bsc#1285267).
- CVE-2026-84303: google.golang.org/grpc: xDS RBAC HTTP filter implementation issue allows for bypass of authorization
  policies via mixed-case or canonical-case header matches (bsc#1279285).
- CVE-2026-84304: google.golang.org/grpc: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation (bsc#1279404).
- CVE-2026-84445: google.golang.org/grpc: DoS via crash due to missing ':authority' and 'Host' headers in gRPC-Go xDS
  servers (bsc#1278945).
- CVE-2026-89090: github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws/protocol/eventstream: malformed EventStream response frames
  containing a crafted header value type byte outside the valid range can cause the host process to terminate
  (bsc#1280681).
- CVE-2026-97032: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder race (bsc#1287441).
- CVE-2026-116585,CVE-2026-116586,CVE-2026-116587: github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4: multiple security issues in
  github.com/go-jose/go-jose before 4.1.6 (bsc#1288337).
